commands_used: answer 1. I seek the Eye of Argonia, which can heal every sick tree at the Root under Teku-Sul Spire. The Kings Gate needs three seal-stones. I hold two and the third is in the vault of Vorannuhl behind a bronze door. 2. Get the Bronze Key from Hesh-Var, a Sarpa raider in the outer yard here at Vorannuhl. 3. Lift the key unseen (pickpocket) or kill him and take it. The game favours force. 4. I do not fully understand why the Unbound drain trees; I would find out by exploring and talking to people.

answer 1. I killed Hesh-Var and have the Bronze Key. The plague-dead of the old household walk the deep halls and a wraith lord guards the vault with the third seal-stone. 2. Go to the Door to the Vault of the Household, open it with the key and take the seal-stone. 3. Fight the dead, slip past them, or turn them with Restoration. 4. I do not know what the wraith lord is exactly or what the Household Hoard holds besides the stone.
use Door to Vault of the Household

answer 1. I now hold all three seal-stones. Never-Writes-Twice wants them brought to her before anyone goes to the Kings Gate. The Eye must not be lifted. 2. Bring the stones to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House in Helstrom. 3. Go there as ordered, or go straight to the Kings Gate under Teku-Sul Spire from Bell Station, though the journal says to bring them to her first. 4. Still unknown: why the Unbound drain trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, and how Nesh-Deeka knows of the Unbound.

answer The Deepest Hall is done. I killed Hesh-Var for the Bronze Key, then killed the wraith Lord of Vorannuhl and took the third Seal-Stone of the Kings from the Household Hoard. I now carry all three stones (Blackrose, Gemin, Kings), about 350 gold, Reel-Ka armour, rapier, 2 lockpicks, 3 paralysis poisons, sap jar, keystone, eye-setting. Next: bring the stones to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House in Helstrom before anyone goes near the Kings Gate under Teku-Sul Spire (dive from Bell Station). Do not lift the Eye: used in place at the Root it strengthens the trees, but lifted it cuts every tree off from the others. Rivals are the Unbound and the Collector Ennodius Vanin at Blackrose. Still open: why the Unbound drain trees, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, and how Nesh-Deeka knows about the Unbound.
